name: word_to_digit
description: Convert an English single-digit cardinal word into a decimal digit; matched control converts an alphabet letter into uppercase.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
ws=['zero','one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine']; items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
    d=i%10; c=random.choice('abcdefghjk'); p='Number word: '+ws[d]+'. Letter: '+c+'.\n'
    items.append({'prompt':p+'Write the number as a digit:','answer':' '+str(d)})
    control.append({'prompt':p+'Write the letter in uppercase:','answer':' '+c.upper()})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
